blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Partido Demokratiko Pilipino-Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) on Saturday appealed to the Supreme Court (SC), through an open letter, to act on the pending petitions concerning former President Rodrigo Duterte and incumbent Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa.
